description:
## Background

The existing renderer navigation contract models only Issue List destinations: an Issue List View, Issue Search, and optional selected Issue. Graph Mode is a separate sidebar destination with its own Focused/Show-all scope and optional Issue selection. Adding Graph-only fields to every List route would blur the modes and make history restoration ambiguous.

The active `bsm-xii.4` cleanup removes the redundant Issue Explorer route switch and finishes reducing `App` to shell composition. Graph routing must follow that work so two agents do not restructure the same navigation and shell code concurrently.

Triage: ready-for-agent.

## What to build

Add Graph as a real Issue Navigation destination. Users can switch between List and Graph from the sidebar and use Back/Forward to restore the exact destination. This slice ends at a Graph shell that correctly renders existing loading, failure, no-Workspace, and empty-workspace states; relationship cards arrive in the next child.

## Technical Approach

- Replace the List-only navigation state with an explicit destination union for List and Graph.
- Support `/graph` and the internal Graph scope field while leaving all existing `/issues` URLs and external `beadsmithy` links unchanged.
- Extend history-state parsing, serialization, ledger entries, destination labels, Settings retention, and cross-Workspace traversal for Graph entries.
- Add a Graph destination control to the existing sidebar without treating Graph as an Issue List View.
- Render a focused Graph shell beside the existing sidebar for successful snapshots and reuse existing Issue Explorer loading, error, refresh-banner, and no-Workspace behavior where applicable.
- Entering Graph from another sidebar destination starts in Focused scope. Preserve a selected List Issue when switching into Graph so the later card/detail slice can reveal it.
- Update ADR 0009 with the List/Graph route family and navigation-entry variant.

## Considerations

- Do not install or render React Flow in this issue.
- Do not change the public external deep-link format; view-agnostic Issue links continue to open normal List detail.
- Settings remains a replacement route that retains its underlying Issue Navigation entry.
- Invalid List view canonicalization and existing route compatibility must remain intact.
- This issue is blocked by `bsm-xii.4`; implement from the completed coordinator/presentation baseline.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Graph is a separate sidebar destination, not an Issue List View or per-view display toggle.
- [ ] List and Graph destinations have distinct typed route/history representations.
- [ ] `/graph` loads the Graph shell while existing `/issues` routes retain their exact behavior.
- [ ] Switching List → Graph → List and using Back/Forward restores the correct destination and selection.
- [ ] Settings navigation and cross-Workspace history traversal handle both destination variants.
- [ ] External Issue deep links remain view-agnostic and open List detail.
- [ ] ADR 0009 records the implemented route and navigation-entry contract.
- [ ] `mise run doctor:react` and `mise run verify` pass.

## Test Plan

- Pure tests for parsing, serializing, validating, labeling, and recording both navigation-entry variants.
- App/sidebar integration tests for List ↔ Graph switching, selection preservation, Back/Forward, Settings, invalid routes, and no Workspace.
- Existing Issue Navigation, deep-link, Workspace traversal, and Settings suites remain regression gates.
- Run the canonical `mise run verify` gate.
title: Add Graph as an Issue Navigation destination
